نمتلك (form VIII)
# نَمْتَلِكُ (namtaliku) /nam.ta.li.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# نُمْتَلَكُ (numtalaku) /num.ta.la.ku/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# نَمْتَلِكَ (namtalika) /nam.ta.li.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# نُمْتَلَكَ (numtalaka) /num.ta.la.ka/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
